# Spec: Note pinning
Spec ID: SPEC-01
Status: draft
Supersedes: —

## Problem & user
Users of the notes API keep many notes, and `GET /notes` gives them no way to keep the few that matter at the top. They must scan or sort client-side each time. This spec lets a user mark a small number of notes as pinned so they come first in the list.

## Goals / Non-goals
Goals:
- A user can pin up to 3 of their notes.
- Pinned notes appear before unpinned notes in `GET /notes`.

Non-goals:
- Ordering rules for unpinned notes (unchanged from today).
- Pinning notes owned by other users or sharing pins.
- Pin limits other than 3, or per-plan limits.

## User stories
- US-1: As an end user, I want to pin a note, so that it appears at the top of my note list.
- US-2: As an end user, I want to unpin a note, so that I can free a slot for another note.
- US-3: As an end user, I want pinned notes listed first by `GET /notes`, so that I find them without scanning.

## Acceptance criteria (EARS)
### API
- [ ] AC-1 WHEN an authenticated user pins one of their own unpinned notes and has fewer than 3 pinned notes, the API shall mark the note as pinned and return [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: which route and method pin a note, and which success status/body — OQ-1].
- [ ] AC-2 IF an authenticated user already has 3 pinned notes and tries to pin another, THEN the API shall reject the request, leave all pins unchanged, and return [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: status code and error body for limit exceeded — OQ-2].
- [ ] AC-3 WHEN an authenticated user unpins one of their pinned notes, the API shall mark the note as not pinned and return [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: route, method and success response for unpinning — OQ-1].
- [ ] AC-4 WHEN an authenticated user calls `GET /notes`, the API shall return all pinned notes of that user before all unpinned notes.
- [ ] AC-5 WHEN an authenticated user calls `GET /notes`, the API shall order the pinned notes among themselves by [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: pin time, creation time, or user-defined order — OQ-3].
- [ ] AC-6 WHEN an authenticated user calls `GET /notes`, the API shall include in each note a pinned indicator whose name and shape are [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: response field name/type for pinned state — OQ-4].
- [ ] AC-7 IF a user tries to pin a note that does not exist or belongs to another user, THEN the API shall not change any pin and shall return [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: 404 for both cases, or 403 for another user's note — OQ-5].
- [ ] AC-8 IF a user pins a note that is already pinned, THEN the API shall leave the pin count unchanged and return [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: idempotent success or an error — OQ-6].
- [ ] AC-9 WHEN a pinned note is deleted through `DELETE /notes/:id`, the API shall stop counting it toward the user's limit of 3.

## Edge cases
- A user with 0 notes calls `GET /notes`: the list is empty, as today.
- A user with 3 pins deletes one, then pins another: the pin succeeds (AC-9, AC-1).
- A user with fewer than 3 notes pins all of them: allowed (AC-1).
